title: Easter Egg, 1 dollar
descriptionPlain: Description A collector keepsake that captures spring in an elegant way through florals, light, and the feeling of a fresh start. It works as a classy Easter gift for those who love beautiful objects and appreciate gestures that stay for years. It also brings you back to what matters most at this time: closeness, good wishes, and a quiet joy you want to return to with every new spring.
